plan.major: Outdoor Recreation in Parks and Tourism - Natural Resource Recreation Emphasis
plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Outdoor Recreation in Parks and Tourism - Natural Resource Recreation Emphasis program page (poid=10892) and its linked official degree map, 'Outdoor Recreation in Parks & Tourism Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Natural Resource (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/14/15/15/16/16/14/14) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to be counted in the major, and students may gain credit through the National Outdoor Leadership School for ORPT 1542, ORPT 2000, ORPT 3040, and ORPT 4860 (signature of ORPT coordinator required). The catalog's Bachelor of Science Degree Requirement (12 credits, math or science) notes that a portion may be met by fulfilling the General Education Core and Breadth Areas, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120. ORPT 4890 Outdoor Recreation Internship is catalogued at 1-8 credits with 8 credits required in all; the map exercises it as two 4-credit rows (allow_repeated_courses set). DISCLOSED, transcribed as printed and not reconciled: the catalog heads its Core Courses block 81-83 credits (Curriculum 84-86 with the 3-credit ORPT Electives block), but the listed core courses and choice blocks itemize to 83-85 (curriculum 86-88); the official map places every named core course and exercises every choice block, and the map and the catalog's printed degree total reconcile exactly at 120, so the plan is recorded at 120 with the header difference disclosed (Rotor-Wing/Biomedical header-error precedent). The map's Spring Year 3 rows print two ranges (Wilderness Medicine Course 1-3 and Free Electives 3-5); they are recorded at 3 (ORPT 1542) and 3, the combination that sums to the printed term total of 16. The catalog's approved BIOL or AGSC core course prints no course list; its slot carries no options. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates them (GEOG 2800, GEOG 2900, ORPT 2800, ORPT 3030, ORPT 3050). Map free rows total 13 credits, recorded as printed (the catalog prints no free-elective figure).
